name: vibedigest-video-intake
description: Existing YouTube caption extraction and source-grounded video context for Codex agents.

interface.shortDescription: Extract video metadata, transcripts, timestamps, and Markdown for agents.
interface.longDescription: Use VibeDigest Video Intake when Codex needs reliable video context from a URL. The plugin routes through a local MCP server and a gateway that retrieves existing YouTube captions from a provider or direct subtitle extraction. Videos without usable captions and audio-only sources are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Use VibeDigest to get the full context for this video URL.
Extract a timestamped transcript and Markdown notes from this YouTube link.
Get reliable video context before summarizing this lecture.
